root_cause.reason: The run names overload of the event streaming platform delaying pull request, Actions, webhook and audit log events. It lacks the trigger: servers near memory limits overloaded by clients immediately reopening connections after failed requests.

contributing_factors/0.reason: No run item mentions servers close to their memory limits or memory growing with connection count.

contributing_factors/1.reason: contributing_factors[0] mentions shifting traffic but never says the shift overloaded other servers and spread the problem.

contributing_factors/2.reason: No run item mentions the audit log service restarting on errors.

contributing_factors/3.reason: contributing_factors[1] says the audit log backlog prolonged recovery, but omits the limited write rate that made it slow.
